description: deviation.rs:590 DeviationStore::active_for_lint() returns impl Iterator<Item=&Deviation> but has no #[must_use] annotation. The sibling methods active_at() (line 582) and expired_at() (line 603) both have #[must_use = "iterator is lazy; collect or iterate to use results"]. Fix: add the same annotation to active_for_lint(). This is an inconsistency that could silently discard a caller's intent to filter lints.
title: [rusty/pkix-lint] active_for_lint missing #[must_use] on lazy iterator
